correctness.rationale: For row-acting chronological rates, adjacent commutators yield an explicit upper-triangular Magnus logarithm. Exact nilpotent exponentiation and row conservation leave only the \((1,4)\) entry potentially negative. Its derivative \(e^{-h}h^2(h^2-8)/8\) yields exactly one positive crossing, with a global minimum at \(\sqrt8\). The general dimension expansion gives the exact coefficient \(-a_1a_2a_3/3\) from one triple jump and two negative shortcuts; lower orders vanish. The three-state comparison follows from \(e^h>1+h+h^2/2\). The standalone verifier passed 674 exact/high-precision assertions; numerical checks are not substituted for proof.

originality.rationale: The qualitative nonpositivity of a truncated Magnus generator is already established by Iserles–Macnamara (2017) and Blanes–Iserles–Macnamara (2021), and is excluded from the novelty claim. Comparisons by matrix family, chronological ordering, retained terms, exact threshold and cubic path coefficient found no implication of this complete four-state positivity-recovery law or the arbitrary-length local obstruction. Specialized priority risk is acknowledged rather than treated as eliminated by search.

value.rationale: This is a complete structural positivity phase diagram for a minimal reverse-ordered Markovian four-state cascade, showing that stronger step-size restrictions cannot restore positivity although sufficiently large integrated pulse masses do. The exact maximal negative transition coefficient quantifies severity, while the universal negative cubic term in longer chains gives a reusable diagnostic. Such an exact self-contained benchmark directly motivates commutator-free or positivity-safeguarded methods; it is more informative than a generic commutator-sign observation.
